chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A mukātab who purchased his freedom and left behind wealth valued at one hundred thousand dirhams, and he has no heir to inherit from him—who inherits him?
He عليه السلام said: “The one who assumes responsibility for his liability inherits from him.”
I said: “And who is the guarantor of his liability?”
He عليه السلام said: “The one responsible for the liabilities of the Muslims.”

key_terms.اشْتَرَى نَفْسَهُ: Completed buying his own freedom from bondage.
key_terms.الضَّامِنُ: The one who bears responsibility or guarantee.
key_terms.جَرَائِرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: The liabilities or indemnities connected with the Muslims.
key_terms.جَرِيرَتَهُ: His legal liability or indemnifiable offense.
key_terms.مُكَاتَبٌ: A slave under a contractual arrangement to purchase his freedom.
key_terms.وَلَا وَارِثَ لَهُ: Having no heir entitled to inherit.

ai.seo_question: Who inherits the estate of a freed mukātab who dies without any heir?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the inheritance of a mukātab who completed the purchase of his freedom and died without an heir. The Imam عليه السلام states that his estate goes to the one who bears his legal liability, identified here as the authority responsible for the liabilities of the Muslims.
